verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs for 10 languages (JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, .NET), plus an official TypeScript-ready JS client, an async, type-hinted Python client, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver. Community reports confirm people build against these clients but note rough edges: the .NET client was still alpha at v1.0, and the Rails gems fell out of step with the server. missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation in the evidence, consistent maturity across all language SDKs (.NET alpha, Rails gem version lag).
